ModMetaData.name: FCP - Fallout Races: Playable Ghoul (Continued) - French TradFix
ModMetaData.author: Zaljerem
ModMetaData.description:
Original mod by RamRod https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1908250492
Continued by Mlie until 1.5 https://github.com/emipa606/FalloutRacesPlayableGhoul https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2343993193
--
This is a Fallout-inspired mod, Playable Ghouls. It requires the Humanoid Alien Races mod.
Currently Glowing ones are about 1.5 Percent Ghouls are 22.9% and Humans are at 75.5%
From a sample size of 135 from 3 5000 point raids.
Ghouls are immune to age related issues and recover from diseases 150% as fast as a human. They generate very little body heat and are susceptible to the cold. They are all staggeringly ugly (or in 1.1 start with -2 Beauty) and that is why most people dislike them. They are naturally found in the Outlander Factions at approximately 1/4 the time of normal humans. They also don't eat as much, needing only 67% the normal amount of food. They are immune to the toxic fallout. They generate less leather as their skin is already peeling off.
Glowing ones generate light that CAN sustain plants!
Credits: Goob for making these amazing textures! Ogliss for giving me the glowing C# code! Taranchuk for updating the C# code! Mlie for updating the C# code! Made HD ghouls courtesy of Goob.
NOT COMPATIBLE WITH Facial Stuff 1.1.
